Name: Ilucie's Derpy Chicken
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Alright, hear me out: I was recently in a "MINISO" store and bought a chicken plushie there that looks absolutely derpy. I saw it, couldn’t stop laughing, and had to take it home right away. Yesterday, I was sitting around and I looked this chicken right in the eyes and knew: THIS IS MY NEXT MOD!

So here it is, the Derpy Chicken!
The Derpy Chicken is a custom animal. It’s not a recolor, so you can keep it alongside your regular chickens (and other custom animals as well).

It drops yellow eggs that you can put into the incubator to hatch more derpy chickens.
Since the Derpy Chicken is so chubby and fluffy, it’s also a great swimmer and will happily take a dip in your pond! ;)


The mod includes i18n support. Default language is English.

Manifest.Name: Derpy Chickens
Manifest.Description: Adds Derpy Chickens as coop animals for CP
